description: C1: Last Hearth's errand for a new colossus (stage 7), teaching what stage 7 adds. Stride over something no smaller giant could pass (Colossus Stride: player.stride.done); break two of the Rimward's three engines at the Chainpit (Shattering Tread splits the ground under them; a colossus breaks the warband on sight); climb the Colossus Steps (a stage-7 size gate) to the Hoarwatch; and tell Maera (world.last_hearth.trials_told). Its completion is stage 8's condition until milestone D (growth_08's growth_requirement). XP: stride 150, engines 250, steps 150, Maera 150 (her dialogue).

stages.objective: Use Colossus Stride to step over a wall
stages.waiting_text: Colossus Stride carries you over anything no taller than half your height: the Fallen King's plinth, a palisade, the Chainpit's lip.

stages.objective: Break the Rimward's engines at the Chainpit
stages.waiting_text: Shattering Tread splits the ground along a line 48 m long: men fall, engines break.

stages.objective: Climb the Colossus Steps to the Hoarwatch
